text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: edge-gateway(us-east-1) 5xx spike detected — 502/504 rate ~18% over last 3m, p95 latency up 400ms. Auto-threshold triggered. Paging team. thread_id=2397654321
jamie: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking routing. anyone seeing customer-facing errors?
liam: yep confirmed errors from the hosted API in us-east-1, e.g. curl shows 502 body: 
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream connection reset"}
```
maria: seeing increased connection timeouts at the edge-proxy layer, spikes correlate with a backend cluster (model-serving-us-east-1-a) CPU saturation.
tariq: looks like a kernel drop rate increase on the NICs for that AZ. I've got telemetry open.
jamie: immediate mitigations: 1) shift a portion of traffic from us-east-1 to us-east-2 region routing policy, 2) enable degraded-fallback on model-serving for compatible smaller-variant, 3) raise proxy connection pool limit temporarily. which one can someone do quickly?
maria: I'll flip degraded-fallback for the affected model group to the smaller-quantized variant (safe fallback) — doing now. patch command: 
```
# runbook step
rctl route set model-group:open-compat --fallback variant:quant-16 --immediate
```
(oncall) applying... done.
liam: shifting 20% traffic to us-east-2 via smart-routing: 
```
console> routing set region-bias us-east-1:0.8 us-east-2:0.2 --reason "502 spike mitigation"
```
applied, traffic shifting. seeing error ratio drop to ~12% after 45s.
tariq: NIC drops decreased after we scaled the proxy pool. I bumped connection limit on edge-proxy hosts in us-east-1. cmd: 
```
ssh edge-proxy-1 -- sudo sysctl -w net.core.somaxconn=1024
```
that reduced conn-queue drops.
sre-roster: note: on-call shift planned — jamie will remain primary until next handoff at +1h, maria as secondary.
jamie: onboarding support: @support-lead can you open a high-priority CS ticket summarizing impacted customers and include estimated ETA for full recovery? we need comms if this persists >30m.
support-lead: creating ticket now and pinging top 10 active customers in us-east-1 with preliminary note. ticket# CS-4487.
maria: degraded-fallback validated: requests now return 200 with smaller variant; slight quality degradation but functional. error rate down to ~6% and p95 latency improving.
liam: still seeing sporadic 504s on long-running requests (>8s) — probable backend model-instance eviction under load. triggering a rollback of a recent infra config? any recent changes last 30m?
jamie: no infra deploys in prod in last 30m, only config changes we did for routing. check autoscaler events.
tariq: autoscaler did spike scale events and failed to attach 2 GPU nodes due to AZ quota. Opening cloud ticket, but immediate workaround: route to healthy nodes in us-east-2 and spin up containers there.
jamie: summary so far: applied fallback + routing shift + proxy limits. customer impact reduced from 18% 5xx -> 6% 5xx. next steps: 1) continue traffic shift to remove pressure from us-east-1 until node capacity stabilizes, 2) coordinate with infra to resolve AZ quota for GPU nodes, 3) keep CS notified.
sre-roster: paging escalation: if 5xx >10% for another 10m, escalate to eng-sre lead. currently below threshold.
maria: starting a targeted drain of unhealthy model instances in us-east-1 and redeploying warm instances from snapshot. will monitor KV cache warming effect.
liam: adding an alert to catch 504s from long requests: rule: response_code=504 and duration>5s -> severity=P1.
jamie: communication: posting short update to #general and to status page (internal) with current mitigation steps and impact. prepping a customer-facing blurb pending CS input.
support-lead: CS blurb drafted: "We are experiencing elevated error rates for requests routed through our US-East edge. We've applied routing and fallback mitigations; most customers are seeing degraded but functional responses. Engineering is actively working to restore full capacity. We will update in 15 minutes." Will share for approval.
tariq: cloud team confirmed quota request submitted; expected resolution in ~25-40m.
maria: error rates holding at ~4-6% for last 10m. p99 latency still elevated but trending down.
jamie: good work — keep monitoring. if we maintain <5% 5xx for 20m, we'll move to mitigation->monitoring state and close active pager. note actions for postmortem: 1) improve autoscaler failure handling for AZ quota, 2) add faster fallback to smaller model variant on hot paths, 3) add edge-proxy runbook step to bump conn limits automatically.
liam: logging snippet for the incident window for SRE postmortem: 
```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z edge-proxy ERROR upstream reset id=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=ms-a-12 cpu=96% conn_drops=23
```
jamie: I'll take the post-incident writeup. tagging for follow-ups: @maria (runtime), @tariq (platform), @liam (sre).
oncall-bot: Incident update recorded. severity=P2, escalation_state=mitigated->monitoring. next check-in in 15m.
